_comment: Milestone B capability registry (bd: shode-roadmap/C-B1, ROADMAP-runtime-10.md SS 3.1). Transcribed verbatim from the 3.17 router style's SS 4 'Routing (19 agents / 7 teams)' table -- one entry per table row (18 rows; the router itself is not a routed-to capability, so it is not listed here, and the orchestrator agent type is retired in 4.0.0, W8). No new capability invented. Read by scripts/route.sh only -- this file is NOT preloaded into any agent context (see delegation note on token budget).
_source: 3.17 router style (Oliver, retired in 4.0.0) SS 4 Routing (19 agents / 7 teams), re-owned in 4.0.1 by the 6 agent types: an owner is `<type>` or `<type>:<domain>` where `<domain>` names references/domain/<domain>.md (a domain capability is owned by `plan` with that reference loaded)
